# vcp_llm_model (Data Source)

Reads a model of the LLM catalog with its prices, providers and capabilities.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_llm_models" "catalog" {}

data "vcp_llm_model" "first" {
  id = data.vcp_llm_models.catalog.models[0].id
}

output "llm_model_prices" {
  value = {
    for p in data.vcp_llm_model.first.prices : p.unit => p.credits
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Model ID, from `vcp_llm_models`.

### Read-Only

- `context_size` (Number) Context size, in tokens.
- `contour` (String) `local` for a model served in the local contour, `external` for an external provider.
- `credit_price` (Attributes) Price of one credit for the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credit_price))
- `default_provider` (String) Slug of the provider the calls go to by default.
- `description` (String) Description, in English.
- `endpoint` (String) Inference address of the model.
- `is_available_to_groups` (Boolean) Whether the model can be granted to a group.
- `is_pii_protected` (Boolean) Whether personal data in the calls is protected.
- `kind` (String) Model kind: `text`, `rag`, `speech`, `image` or `video`. New kinds may be added over time.
- `name` (String) Display name, in English.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices of the model by unit and variant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))
- `providers` (Attributes List) Providers serving the model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))
- `storage_countries` (List of String) Countries the data of the calls is stored in.
- `supports_streaming` (Boolean) Whether the model streams its answers.
- `supports_tools` (Boolean) Whether the model calls tools.
- `tech_title` (String) Model name the inference calls take in the `model` field.
- `unit_kind` (String) Unit the model is billed in: `tokens`, `units`, `bytes` or `none`.
- `vendor` (String) Model vendor.

<a id="nestedatt--credit_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credit_price`

Read-Only:

- `basis` (String) Where the price comes from: `package`, `project_discount`, `individual` or `pay_as_you_go`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code, e.g. `RUB`.
- `package_name` (String) Package the price comes from, for the `package` basis.
- `price_per_credit` (Number) Price of one credit.
- `tax_label` (String) Tax caption of the price: `nds_excluded` or `vat_excluded`.
- `valid_through` (String) Last day the price holds, `YYYY-MM-DD`.


<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `credits` (Number) Price in credits.
- `money` (Number) Price in the currency of `credit_price`, where priced.
- `unit` (String) Unit the price is quoted for, e.g. `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `request`, `audio_minute`. New units may be added over time.
- `variant` (String) Price variant, where the model has several.


<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `context_length` (Number) Context length at the provider, in tokens.
- `discount` (Number) Discount of the provider, percent.
- `is_live` (Boolean) Whether the provider serves calls now.
- `max_completion_tokens` (Number) Longest answer at the provider, in tokens.
- `name` (String) Provider name.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices at the provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers--prices))
- `slug` (String) Provider slug.
- `supports_reasoning` (Boolean) Whether reasoning is served.
- `supports_structured_outputs` (Boolean) Whether structured outputs are served.
- `supports_tools` (Boolean) Whether tool calls are served.
- `supports_web_search` (Boolean) Whether web search is served.
- `variant` (String) Model variant the provider serves.

<a id="nestedatt--providers--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers.prices`

Read-Only:

- `credits` (Number) Price in credits.
- `money` (Number) Price in the currency of `credit_price`, where priced.
- `unit` (String) Unit the price is quoted for, e.g. `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `request`, `audio_minute`. New units may be added over time.
- `variant` (String) Price variant, where the model has several.
